opening: I've lost some of the vision in both eyes.
It all started 3 years ago, a few days after I accidentally swallowed the niclosamide.
Over these 3 years my vision problems have stayed the same.
Three years ago I accidentally swallowed four 1250 mg boluses of a veterinary niclosamide product.
At that time the doctors thought I had optic neuritis in both eyes.
I was treated with a short course of high-dose steroid tablets for it.

opening.text: I've lost some of the vision in both eyes and I see flashes of light. It all started 3 years ago, a few days after I accidentally swallowed four 1250 mg boluses of a veterinary niclosamide product. At that time the doctors thought I had optic neuritis in both eyes, and I was treated with a short course of high-dose steroid tablets for it. Over these 3 years my vision problems have stayed the same.
